name: Ukor
summary: Near the eastern path outside the Valley of Trials, Ukor rests after carrying supplies from Razor Hill. The training grounds already had plenty, and he hopes the provisions can still help his people.

sections.title: A Peon's Errand
sections.body: Ukor rests by the eastern road outside the Valley of Trials, tired from carrying food south from Razor Hill. Orc peons often spend their days cutting lumber or hauling rocks under harsh taskmasters. Ukor chose to bring provisions to the recruits on his own initiative. He crossed Durotar's red plains, where scorpids and boars prowl, only to find the training grounds already well-stocked. His bundle was not needed. Now he asks passing young adventurers to carry the provisions back north to Innkeeper Grosk.

faq.answer: Ukor rests along the road leading east from the Valley of Trials in southern Durotar. He is an earnest orc peon.

faq.q: Why is Ukor standing by the road with a sack of food?
faq.answer: Ukor carried rations from Razor Hill to feed the young warriors training in the Valley of Trials. When he arrived, he found plenty of provisions already there, and the sack was not needed.

faq.q: What does Ukor ask passing travelers to do?
faq.answer: Ukor asks travelers heading north toward Razor Hill to return the bundle to Innkeeper Grosk. He is too afraid of the beasts along the road to carry it back himself.

angles.text: Orc peons do the hard physical labor that helps build the new Horde. Ukor shows that even humble laborers want to support Durotar's warriors.
For new recruits emerging from their trials, helping Ukor is an early chance to support the everyday movement of supplies between Horde settlements.
